skills.compatibility: Pure prompt-based; the bundled prompt_audit.py needs Python 3.8+ only.

skills.name: video-script-writer
skills.desc: Write video scripts: dialogue, narration, shot descriptions, timing markers, and platform-compliant titles/captions. Supports multiple video types (talking character, meme, tutorial, vlog, short). Use when the user needs a script for a video before production. 当用户要求 写视频脚本 / 短视频文案 / 分镜脚本 时使用。 Do NOT use for generating video files (script text only).
skills.compatibility: Pure prompt-based; may call LLM for generation. No API keys required.

skills.name: video-subtitles
skills.desc: Generate SRT subtitles and platform-optimized captions from video script. Supports multi-language, timing sync, and per-platform caption formats. Use when the user asks to 加字幕 / 生成字幕 / 做字幕文件 / 短视频字幕 / 烧录字幕 / generate subtitles / add captions / make an SRT. Do NOT use for burning subtitles into video (see video-editor), translating audio (use a transcription tool), or styling thumbnails.
skills.compatibility: Pure Python, no external dependencies. No API keys required.

skills.name: video-thumbnail
skills.desc: Design and generate video thumbnails/covers per platform spec (douyin/bilibili/tiktok/youtube), via ffmpeg frame extraction or the image-generation gateway (scripts/thumbnail.py; --mock only for downstream wiring). Use when the user asks to 做视频封面 / 设计封面图 / 缩略图 / 封面图 / video thumbnail / design a cover / YouTube cover image, as the final step before publishing. Do NOT use for generating the video itself, or for in-video subtitles.
skills.compatibility: Route A (gateway) needs the image-generation gateway; Route B (frame extract) needs ffmpeg. No API keys required (gateway auth optional via GATEWAY_API_KEY env).

skills.name: video-voice-synth
skills.desc: Text-to-speech for video production via scripts/voice_synth.py: single-line and batch synthesis against a local TTS gateway, per-scene WAV files with the scene_{id}.wav naming contract, six built-in voices (baby/adult/mascot/narrator), --mock silent placeholders for downstream wiring. Use when the script is ready and audio is needed before lip-sync, or when the user asks to 配音 / 合成语音 / 文字转语音 / TTS / 给视频配个声音 / text to speech / generate voiceover / synthesize narration. Do NOT use for cloning a real person's voice without documented consent.
skills.compatibility: Requires the local TTS gateway (default 127.0.0.1:30081) or --mock mode; the script itself needs Python 3.8+ only. No API keys required (gateway auth optional via GATEWAY_API_KEY env).

skills.name: visual-style-anchor
skills.desc: Create a reusable visual style anchor for a video or image project: one-page style guide locking color palette, lighting scheme, materials, era, and medium texture — plus a character consistency card (identity line, wardrobe, props, forbidden changes) that keeps every generated shot on-model. Use when the user asks to 定视觉风格 / 风格设定 / 角色设定 / 保持角色一致 / 人物不跑脸 / style guide / character sheet / 视觉统一 before batch generation. Do NOT use for writing per-shot prompts (use video-prompt-engineer), nor for generating the images themselves.
skills.compatibility: Pure prompt-based design skill; no scripts, no API keys.

skills.name: web-search
skills.desc: Free web search via SearXNG (primary) and DuckDuckGo (fallback) with no API keys required. Auto-fallback, 24h cache, deep search mode. Use when the agent needs to find information from the web without paid API keys. 当用户要求 搜索 / 查资料 / 联网找信息 时使用。 Do NOT use for multi-source synthesis reports (use deep-research).
skills.compatibility: Requires network access. No API keys required.

skills.name: wechat-mp-publisher
skills.desc: 微信公众号文章发布自动化。基于官方草稿箱 API：获取 access_token、上传正文图片与封面素材、创建草稿（draft/add）、提交发布（freepublish）。当用户提到 公众号发文、微信公众号发布、公众号草稿、推送文章到公众号、publish to WeChat Official Account、wechat mp article、wechat official account draft、post article to weixin mp 时使用。所有写操作默认 dry-run，确认后才真正执行。 Do NOT use for personal WeChat chat messages (official account API only).
skills.compatibility: Requires network access to api.weixin.qq.com and valid session credentials in environment variables. Python 3.8+.

skills.name: weibo-publisher
skills.compatibility: Requires network access to api.weibo.com / weibo.com and valid session credentials in environment variables. Python 3.8+.

skills.name: xiaohongshu-publisher
skills.compatibility: Requires network access to www.xiaohongshu.com and valid session credentials in environment variables. Python 3.8+.

skills.name: zhihu-content-manager
skills.desc: 知乎内容发布与管理自动化工具。支持文章发布、编辑、删除、草稿清理、话题标签管理、封面图上传、乱码检测与修复。当用户提到 知乎发文、知乎发布、知乎文章、知乎回答、知乎草稿、知乎专栏、知乎乱码、修复知乎内容、publish to zhihu、zhihu article、zhihu draft、zhihu column、fix zhihu mojibake 或任何涉及知乎内容管理的操作时触发。 Do NOT use for publishing to platforms other than zhihu.com.
skills.compatibility: Requires network access to www.zhihu.com and valid session credentials in environment variables. Python 3.8+.

packs.name: AI Agent Development
packs.desc: Build production-grade AI agents, design multi-agent workflows, MCP servers, feature flags, and self-evaluation.
packs.desc_zh: 构建生产级 AI Agent、设计多 Agent 工作流、MCP 服务、功能开关与自评。

packs.name: AI Media Toolkit
packs.desc: Generate videos, images, covers, and music from prompts through a local generation gateway.
packs.desc_zh: 通过本地生成网关用提示词生成视频、图片、封面与配乐：文生/图生全流程（提交、轮询、下载交付）。

packs.name: AI Research & Writing
packs.desc: Research a topic and turn it into a structured article: multi-round search, outline, draft, edit, SEO.
packs.desc_zh: 从选题调研到成稿发布的长文生产链路：多轮检索与报告综合、大纲搭建、初稿撰写、风格润色、关键词与平台规则优化，以及学术选题的研究空白识别与投稿匹配。

packs.name: AI Video Pipeline
packs.name_zh: AI 短视频生产流水线
packs.desc: End-to-end short-video production: script, voice, lip-sync, assembly, subtitles, thumbnail.
packs.desc_zh: 从脚本到成片的一条龙短视频生产线：脚本撰写、配音合成、口型对齐、剪辑合成、字幕、封面图。六个技能按序衔接，输出可直接发布的竖屏视频。

packs.name: API Development & Testing
packs.desc: Review REST API designs and generate integration/contract test suites.
packs.desc_zh: 审查 REST API 设计并生成集成/契约测试套件。

packs.name: System Architecture
packs.desc: Design system architecture, plan zero-downtime migrations, and navigate monorepos.
packs.desc_zh: 设计系统架构、规划零停机迁移、驾驭 monorepo。

packs.name: Audio Studio
packs.desc: AI audio production chain: turn a topic or document into a segmented podcast script (spoken words only - TTS reads everything), direct voice synthesis with a voice catalog and per-character casting, and publish with shownotes, timestamped chapters, and platform metadata. Topic in, publishable episode out, no step left dangling.
packs.desc_zh: AI 音频生产链条：把选题或文档变成分段播客脚本（纯口播词——TTS 会把一切都读出来），按声音目录做角色选声与合成参数执导，并以 shownotes、时间戳章节、平台元数据收尾发布。选题进、可发布节目出，链条不断头。方法论借鉴 Kokoro/Qwen3-TTS 生态与 Podify/inference.sh 实践并已署名。

packs.name: Chat Prompt Craft
packs.desc: Prompt engineering for conversational AI assistants (Doubao, ChatGPT, Kimi, DeepSeek, etc.): one-shot task prompts built on the five-element formula (role + background + task + requirements + format), agent/persona system prompts on the five-section skeleton, reverse constraints that kill filler, and heuristic structural audit.
packs.desc_zh: 面向对话式 AI 助手（豆包、ChatGPT、Kimi、DeepSeek 等）的提示词工程：五要素公式（角色 + 背景 + 任务 + 要求 + 格式）写一次性任务提示词，五段骨架写智能体人设 system prompt，反向约束砍废话，附启发式结构审计脚本。方法论提炼自豆包官方教程与 Coze 最佳实践并已署名。

packs.name: CI/CD Pipeline
packs.desc: Generate pragmatic CI/CD pipelines, release gates, and spec-driven development workflows.
packs.desc_zh: 生成务实的 CI/CD 流水线、发布门禁与规范驱动开发流程。

packs.name: Code Planning & Generation
packs.desc: Turn vague requests into structured plans, then into working code; diagnose and fix failures.
packs.desc_zh: 把模糊需求变成可执行代码：三层瀑布式意图识别、结构化实施计划、两档代码生成（模板引擎 + LLM）、运行时故障诊断与调试清单。

packs.name: Code Review
packs.desc: Review pull requests, analyze code quality, audit dependencies and tech debt across languages.
packs.desc_zh: 审查 PR、分析代码质量、审计依赖与技术债，覆盖多语言。

packs.name: Containers & Orchestration
packs.desc: Dockerfile optimization, docker-compose, Helm charts, and Kubernetes operators.
packs.desc_zh: Dockerfile 优化、docker-compose、Helm Chart 与 Kubernetes Operator。

packs.name: Content Publishing Automation
packs.name_zh: 内容多平台发布自动化
packs.desc: Publish, edit and manage articles/videos on Chinese platforms (Zhihu, cnblogs, WeChat MP, Juejin, CSDN, Jianshu, Bilibili, Toutiao, Baijiahao, Xiaohongshu, Weibo, Douban, V2EX, SegmentFault, OSChina, Douban, Static Blogs) with battle-tested platform knowledge, plus a cross-post orchestrator and AI cover-image generation.
packs.desc_zh: 在知乎、博客园、微信公众号、掘金、CSDN、简书、B站、头条、百家号、小红书、微博、豆瓣、V2EX、SegmentFault、开源中国、静态博客等中文平台发布、编辑、管理内容，沉淀实战平台经验；附跨平台发布编排器与 AI 封面图生成。

packs.name: Data, ML & Scientific Computing
packs.desc: Data pipelines, feature engineering, mathematical modeling, simulation, and ML training workflows.
packs.desc_zh: 数据与建模的完整工具箱：ETL 清洗变换、特征工程、数学建模与求解器选型、蒙特卡洛仿真、结果可视化、ML 训练流水线与超参调优、指标体系解读。

packs.name: Database Design & Management
packs.desc: Design schemas, ERD diagrams, migrations, and optimize SQL queries.
packs.desc_zh: 设计表结构、ERD 图、迁移方案，并优化 SQL 查询。

packs.name: Edu Craft
packs.desc: Teaching and knowledge-product chain: learning-contract-driven course design with checkpoint breakdown, strict exercise generation (open-ended questions, MCQ banned, rubric included), and a Feynman loop explainer (diagnose, repair, teach-back, transfer). Topic in, mastery-ready course kit out.
packs.desc_zh: 教学与知识产品链条：学习契约驱动的课程设计（checkpoint 分解）、严格习题生成（开放题防蒙、附评分标准）、费曼循环讲解器（诊断→修复→回讲→迁移）。主题进、可交付掌握式课程包出。方法论借鉴费曼学习法生态与掌握式学习实践并已署名。

packs.name: GitHub Collaboration
packs.desc: Parallel worktrees, conventional-commit changelogs, and PR review on GitHub.
packs.desc_zh: 并行 worktree、Conventional Commits 变更日志与 GitHub PR 审查。

packs.name: Growth Marketing
packs.desc: E-commerce and growth marketing chain: framework-driven product copy (FAB/PAS/AIDA with objection handling), campaign design with single-variable A/B variant pairs, and channel adaptation with machine-checked fit rules (word budgets, CTA counts per platform). Product facts in, launch-ready channel variants out.
packs.desc_zh: 电商与增长营销链条：框架驱动的商品文案（FAB/PAS/AIDA + 异议处理）、单变量 A/B 变体对的活动策划、附机器适配校验（各平台字数预算与 CTA 约束）的渠道适配。商品事实进、可投放渠道变体出。方法论借鉴 AIDA/PAS/FAB 直复营销框架与开源营销技能生态并已署名。

packs.name: Incident Response & SRE
packs.desc: Command incidents, generate runbooks, and define SLOs/error budgets.
packs.desc_zh: 事故指挥、生成 runbook、定义 SLO 与错误预算。

packs.name: Infrastructure as Code
packs.desc: Terraform patterns, observability design, and Kubernetes operators.
packs.desc_zh: Terraform 模式、可观测性设计与 Kubernetes Operator。

packs.name: Office Productivity
packs.desc: Daily office work: decks, spreadsheets, resumes, meeting minutes.
packs.desc_zh: 日常办公四件套：PPT 制作、Excel 清洗分析、简历岗位定制、会议纪要结构化。

packs.name: Performance Profiling
packs.desc: Profile CPU/memory/I/O bottlenecks in Node.js, Python, and Go.
packs.desc_zh: 剖析 Node.js、Python、Go 的 CPU/内存/IO 瓶颈。

packs.name: Security & Secrets
packs.desc: Set up secret vaults and manage environment-variable hygiene.
packs.desc_zh: 搭建密钥库并管理环境变量卫生。

packs.name: Test-Driven Development
packs.desc: Write unit tests, fixtures, mocks, and guide red-green-refactor cycles.
packs.desc_zh: 编写单元测试、fixture、mock，并引导红绿重构循环。

packs.name: Video Design Studio
packs.desc: Pre-production design layer for AI video: storyboards with continuity contracts, cinematic shot lists from recipe cards, cross-model text-to-video prompt engineering with structural audit, and reusable visual style anchors with character consistency cards.
packs.desc_zh: AI 视频的前期设计层：分镜设计（节拍表 + 逐场景 prompt 对 + 连续性约束表，附机器校验）、12 卡镜头清单设计、跨模型文生视频提示词工程（六槽位结构 + 机器审计）、视觉风格锚与角色一致性卡。方法论借鉴 video-storyboard / video-shotcraft / visual-skills 等开源项目并已署名。

packs.name: Viral Entertainment
packs.desc: Special entertainment scenarios: talking-character viral shorts.
packs.desc_zh: 特别娱乐场景：AI 宝宝播客等会说话角色的病毒式短视频完整流水线（含合规标识与角色一致性纪律）。

packs.name: Visual Design Studio
packs.desc: AI visual design chain: interpret a vague brief into a design spec (purpose, platform size, style anchor), engineer text-to-image prompts with model dialects and text-rendering rules, and audit output against platform layout specs (safe areas, ratios, text budgets). One brief flows through spec -> prompt -> audit without leaving the chain.
packs.desc_zh: AI 视觉设计链条：把模糊需求翻译成设计规格单（用途/平台尺寸/风格锚），按模型方言与文字渲染规则写文生图 prompt，并按平台版面规格（比例/安全区/文字预算）审计产出。一条需求从规格到 prompt 到审计全程不出链。方法论借鉴 Anthropic canvas-design / designskills / Replicate prompting 指南并已署名。
